name: Digital Seclusion
source:
Isolated in a room repurposed into a personal shrine to esoteric Japanese media. Our nameless protagonist has dedicated himself to a collection of retro Japanese computer games, with a particular fondness for early visual novels. Although decaying in a slovenly existence to the untrained eye, his retreat into digital life is enriched by the scripted interactions with various charming 2D girls. His one purpose in life is to chronicle his thoughts and reflections on each of the digital worlds he immerses himself in. However, one day while pulling out the box of another visual novel to review, a girl leaps straight out of the cover art and begins interacting with him face to face. And perhaps most shocking of all to him, in a completely unscripted manner.

[From [url=https://thezalor.itch.io/digital-seclusion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一间被改造成冷门日本文艺作品私人圣殿的房间里，无名的主人公与世隔绝。他全心投入收藏复古日本电脑游戏，尤其钟爱早期视觉小说。在外人眼中，他过着邋遢、日渐腐朽的生活，可对他而言，退入数字世界后，与形形色色迷人的二次元女孩们依照剧本互动，反倒让生活丰富起来。他唯一的人生目标，就是记录自己沉浸过的每一个数字世界，以及由此产生的思考与感悟。然而某一天，当他取出另一部准备评介的视觉小说盒子时，一个女孩竟从封面画中跳了出来，开始与他面对面交流。而或许最让他震惊的，是这场交流，完全没有事先写好的剧本。

[摘自[url=https://thezalor.itch.io/digital-seclusion]itch.io[/url]]
